title: Residential Construction and Maintenance
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement in Residential Construction and Maintenance with emphasis on employment preparation
outcomes: Demonstrate safe job site practices.  (ILOs: Critical thinking, Communication.)
Build and finish to specs a simple wooden structure using standard industry materials and techniques. (ILOs: Information Competency.)
Install and repair plumbing systems commonly encountered in residential and commercial buildings. (ILOs: Critical Thinking, Information Competency.)
Interpret construction and site layout requirements from technical drawings. (ILOs: Communication.)
Explain the permitting and inspection process for a local jurisdiction. (ILOs: Critical Thinking, Information Competency.)
Apply basic business principles to the construction field. (ILOs: Ethics, Personal Development.)
